newsitem.title: UK: UK gilts settle 4/32 higher, sentiment much better.
newsitem.headline: UK gilts settle 4/32 higher, sentiment much better.

text.p: 1622 GMT - UK gilts settled modestly higher on the day in thin pre-holiday trade with sentiment much improved. Traders said gilts' quick recovery after big losses earlier in the week bodes well for stable end to year. * March gilt futures settle 4/32 higher at 109-06

Earlier in the session, national accounts data showed GDP grew 0.7 percent in the third quarter, downwardly revised from 0.8 percent, although the year-on-year growth rate was unrevised at 2.4 percent. The data also showed a current account deficit of 71 million stg compared with a surplus of 344 million stg in the second quarter.
"Today's figures for GDP and the current account in the third quarter of this year paint a farily rosy picture of the UK economy," said Andrew Cates, UK economist at UBS.
But come the new year, markets will return to thinking about the timing of the next rate rise, traders said.
The short sterling strip is discounting up to a half-point rate rise by the end of the first quarter. March short sterling settled at 93.29, up 0.03.
